title: IT & Tech Salary Estimator — Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow, NCR & Remote | techcadd Lucknow
metaDescription: Free instant tech salary estimator. Compare fresher and 2-year packages for Full Stack, Python AI, Data Science, Cyber Security, Cloud, and CAD across Lucknow, Delhi NCR, and remote roles.

hero.text: Pick a role to see fresher and 2-year salary ranges across Uttar Pradesh/Lucknow, Delhi NCR and remote work — and exactly where our graduates get hired.

logic: range = base[role][level] × multiplier[location][level], each bound rounded to 1 decimal (Math.round(10x)/10); label '₹{low}–{high} LPA' (integers without decimals, otherwise 1 decimal). Progress bar width = min(100, round(((low+high)/2)/15*100))%. Two rows: 'Fresher' and 'After 2 Years'. Caption: 'Indicative ranges for entry-level {role} roles in {location}, compiled from public job-market listings. Actual offers vary by employer, skillset and interview performance.' Then 'Where {role} graduates get hired' with the hiredAt list and a course link button. Then consultation card 'Free consultation call' / 'Talk through {a|an} {role} career' / 'Google Verified' / '4.9 · 556+ reviews' (link to Google reviews) / buttons 'Call Now — {{phone}}' and 'Request a Free Callback' (opens same lead modal as Training Matcher, title 'Talk through {article} {role} career', course={role}) / 'Always free. No fee for the call, no obligation to enrol.' Footer: 'Not sure which role fits you? Take the Career Track quiz.'
